- **The new one:** in the Dwarkesh Podcast interview published 12 November 2025, Nadella said the economic spread that "took 70 years, maybe 150 years for the Industrial Revolution, may happen in 20 years, 25 years." He hedged it with "may" and "if we're lucky". It's about AI's effect on the economy rather than a capability, so it only just qualifies.
- **The Sora claim:** the official Build keynote transcript for 19 May 2025 says "Sora is coming next week". That matches 2025-05-19-nadella-sora-on-azure-next-week.toml. Other dated lines in that transcript were spoken by Kevin Scott or Sam Altman, so I left them out.
- **The February Dwarkesh interview:** in the part I could read, Nadella calls self-declared AGI milestones "nonsensical benchmark hacking" and sets out 10% world growth as the real test. He attaches no date, so I didn't list it.
